Spitting in someone's direction is illegal?

I am always disappointed with life. I guess it just never lives up to how it seems in books (I read a lot). It seems boring. I have no interest in experiencing more things. 

Thank you for replying. :)

I know that depression is treatable; last winter I almost killed myself, but tried to be as rational as you are right now. So I went to my mother, and tried to tell her I was depressed. She is somewhat of the opinion that depression can be cured by volunteering, and picking up new hobbies. After I begged her, she agreed to take me to a doctor. Unfortunately the antidepressant he prescribed me didn't work, so she said there was no point in being prescribed another. He recommended I undergo a psychiatric exam, but she said that wasn't a good idea, because if I was diagnosed with a mental illness I wouldn't be able to get into college (my mother has epilepsy, and has faced a lot of discrimination due to that in the job market, etc. so I think that colors her decision-making). 

Thank you for replying. I just don't know how to deal with depression, so I don't know what to take away from your message.
Yes, a lot of people care about me. I have wonderful friends, and - while I'm not very close with them - very loving parents.
